description: This file is the entry point for a React web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, global CSS, and the main App component, then mounts the App into the DOM element with ID 'root' within a React.StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render React components into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the DOM at the root node.
